templates.format: In {setting}, {protagonist} lives a normal life—{initial_situation} However, everything changes {main_conflict} In the end, {twist_complication_goal}

initial_situation.text: A retired dragon hunter opens a small bakery in a quiet mountain village.
A college student inherits a haunted apartment from an eccentric distant relative.
An AI awakens inside an abandoned colony starship drifting through deep space.
The kingdom celebrates its thousandth year of unbroken peace and prosperity.
A disgraced alchemy professor takes a night job at an illegal potion clinic.
A solitude-loving lighthouse keeper discovers a siren washed ashore during a cosmic storm.
A cybernetic bounty hunter takes one last routine contract before retiring to Mars.
A quiet antique restorer uncovers an unlabeled leather journal written in backwards cipher.
A disgraced royal knight works as a quiet tavern bouncer in the city slums.
A subterranean cartographer discovers an uncharted bioluminescent forest beneath the capitol.
An undercover detective investigates a secretive aristocratic dining club.
A planetary miner unearths a humming crystalline structure deep inside an asteroid core.

main_conflict.text: ...until mysterious disappearances begin plaguing the surrounding countryside.
...when a forbidden relic of catastrophic power is stolen from the high vault.
...after an ancient god starts speaking directly through their nightly dreams.
...because a rival empire unexpectedly launches a surprise full-scale invasion.
...when time begins fracturing, causing past and future events to bleed together.
...after discovering that the city's governor has secretly put a bounty on their head.
...when an automated orbital defense grid goes rogue and locks down the continent.
...after an accidental magical surge links their life force with a notorious outlaw boss.
...when the sun fails to rise one morning, leaving the world in perpetual twilight.
...after realizing their closest companion is carrying a contagious shadow curse.

twist_complication_goal.text: The real enemy behind the catastrophe is secretly the protagonist's future self.
Every victory earned erases one precious core memory from their mind.
The villain is secretly protecting humanity from an even more devastating cosmic truth.
The protagonist must work alongside the exact person who betrayed them years ago.
The magical power keeping them alive is slowly corrupting the surrounding land.
They only have 72 hours to resolve the crisis before the rift becomes permanent.
Unlocking the final door requires sacrificing the memory of the person they love most.
Uncovering the truth reveals that the entire world is an artificial memory simulation.
The artifact can cure the plague, but activating it will permanently strip all magic from the realm.

protagonist.text: an ambitious young archivist with forbidden knowledge
a sharp-tongued mercenary captain hiding a tragic past
a rogue starship engineer with illegal cybernetic implants
a disgraced noble turned street-smart informant

setting.text: an ancient floating citadel above a sea of clouds
